name: otome_mob_duel
about: Otome Game Mob story Short: reborn into an otome game where women rule, Leon hates this world and calls himself a mere background mob - then throws the glove: let's duel, Prince. The drop wakes his lost-item armor Arroganz and it flattens the prince's friends one by one; he ends coolly noting that right now, he's better.
anime: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs

story.why: this otome game really favors the women
I'm a background character - a mob

outro.why: for now, they can't compete with me

title: Just A Background MOB, He Challenges The Prince To A DUEL
hook: Reborn as a nobody in an otome game where women rule everything, Leon had one card left to play: a lost-item armor nobody knew about.
